objective: Harden holyagent setup --scope and --undo against the three non-blocking findings of the security and code reviews.
constraints: (1) Undo removes only what setup added: setup records, per settings file, the exact key paths and deny entries it added (+ lines) in a small JSON record kept outside the project (under the user config dir, e.g. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude, in a holyagent subfolder, keyed by the settings file's absolute path), merging with earlier records. --undo removes a recorded key only while its value still equals what setup wrote, removes only recorded deny entries, then clears the record. A value setup did not add (no record, e.g. it was already there or setup ran before this change) is kept and reported with ~ and a hint; add --force-undo? No: keep it simple, report it and let the user remove it by hand. Decode the record with Effect Schema (onExcessProperty error).

(2) For --scope project|local, use the git top-level only when it is the cwd or an ancestor of it (resolve both with realpath); otherwise fall back to cwd and say so in the report. Reason: a crafted core.worktree must not redirect the write.
(3) For --scope project|local, refuse (a ! line, nothing written) when the target settings file or its .claude folder is a symlink. User scope keeps today's behavior.
Effect, Schema, JSDoc per .claude/CLAUDE.md. Update the setup help text in packages/runtime/src/cli/setup.ts and packages/integrations/claude/src/setup-command.md if behavior wording changes.

Do not run mise run build and do not edit packages/integrations/claude/dist: another writer runs in parallel and the commit hook regenerates dist. Run the type-check, lint, format check and the tests that cover your change (node_modules/.bin/mise run check, lint, fmt:check or the equivalent tasks in mise.toml, plus bun test on the affected files); name any check you could not run.
No version-control writes, no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done and checked, stop and report; name unrequested features instead of adding them. Report in under 350 words.

criteria.text: record-based undo: undo removes only keys and deny entries setup recorded and that still hold setup's value; pre-existing equal values are kept with ~
worktree guard: a git top-level that is not an ancestor of cwd is ignored
symlink guard: project/local scope refuses a symlinked target or .claude folder
tests: each of the three has a test that fails without the change; existing setup tests pass
checks: type-check, lint, format check pass
